It's called the Atlas update.

It will be for the better, but for now the Dev's need to iron out any creases. The fact there is more hackers is not to do with the update, unless they are fly and a fly anti-cheat has been removed. 

Like when avicore, the previous plugin, was released, I myself included hated things but it will only get better and to the same standard so don't worry :D
